environment.label: m6-prepare
environment.notes: Stage 1 front-end on scans and photos (page detection and perspective, light flattening, staff-line dewarping, photo denoising and sharpening, quality gate), then Audiveris 5.11.0 and Stage 5. Scans are transcribed prepared and as uploaded, keeping the run Lilyscan expects to be better. PDF and PNG use the same cached engine output as m5-repair. Dev laptop, three Audiveris processes in parallel.
